exposure: induction of labor with Propess (controlled-release dinoprostone pessary)
induction of labor with Prostin E2 (dinoprostone vaginal suppository)
cohort: 322 pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy, fetal cephalic presentation, and a Bishop score of 4 or less who underwent labor induction.
finding: Induction of labor with Propess was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to Prostin E2, but there was no significant difference in other outcomes.
